RUN32 0.32 Menu-Fast: rebuilt native menu cache/metadata/status/title objects and shaders; replaced only the existing catalog font in RomFS from the validated existing runtime; removed standalone launcher NRO and its Homebrew download by user request; removed Add App tile; X opens Add App, A launches the selected application. Civ7-UI-Cache-Fix: corrected ignored cache rename failure when the destination already exists. Added validated temporary-file recovery and cache write diagnostics. Regression reproduces old failure and tests replacement, denied rename, interrupted publication and corrupt cache rejection. Rebuilt native/ExeFS with unchanged NPDM; IZA and ROMFS unchanged. Console cache repair measured first_present 14410.250 ms -> 203.140 ms on prior native; new binary requires separate console verification.

Lifecycle-Audit-1: status publication respects host hold and active module ownership; battery sessions close after sampling including failed queries; remove SD clock fallback; retire optional driver pipeline cache before app/host entry; add bounded transition-only memory/worker/presentation diagnostics. IZA, ROMFS, modules and lifecycle safety checks unchanged. Console crash cause and fix remain unconfirmed.
